entities.summary: Gu Hong is a Chinese boxer and Olympic medalist. She is a two-time silver medalist at the AIBA Women's World Boxing Championships and a three-time gold medalist at the Asian Amateur Boxing Championships. She won a silver medal in the women's welterweight event at the 2020 Summer Olympics.
